label: Every actual cause of an actual distinct esse, other than the thing, is an efficient cause of it
paraphrase: OPEN analyst bridge, attribution deferred: for every x that actually exists with esse distinct from its essence (DistinctEsseAt), every y other than x that is in act as to being and causes x's esse (CausesIn y x esse, mode unspecified, DEF-CAUSE-OF-PERFECTION) is an efficient cause of x's esse (EfficientlyCausesEsse y x, CAUSING_AN_EFFECT_6's efficiency conjunct). It is the passage from a mode-unspecified to an efficient cause of being, restricted to actual causes of actual distinct esse. It fails if an actual being other than x can account for x's esse as a formal or constitutive principle, an exemplar, an end, or a structure, without being an agent: NonEfficientCauseControl satisfies the De ente and q.3 a.4 mode-unspecified conclusions and falsifies it. Neither the De ente nor the q.3 a.4 text states it: De ente rejects only efficient causation of esse by the thing's own quiddity ('dico sicut a causa efficiente'), and q.3 a.4's conclusion does not name the mode.
